name: PORTRAIT-BLINK
note: A portrait that blinks now and then.  (sample: seed 3832)

form.subject: a grizzled space captain with a scar and a grey beard
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3)

sample_command: pixelmon 'a grizzled space captain with a scar and a grey beard, dosart_vga, 256-color VGA pixel art, character portrait, 1990s DOS game' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora dosart-vga.safetensors --lora-strength 0.8 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3)' --out 128x128 --palette none --despeckle 1 --no-sprite-suffix --pixel-size 1x1 --animate blink --seed 3832
